source_kind: archive checkout equivalent; no Git metadata

attribution.minimal: native agent loop + native approval/persistence, with shared business tool
attribution.equivalent: shared host authorization, source invalidation, exact payload, request key and reconciliation around native engines

limits: Native-only full six-fault matrix is not measured; equivalent profile measures shared-host composition
No real model, real commerce data or professional review available (user confirmed none)
Source withdrawal covers host cached-result replay; native history was not measured
Duplicates are sequential across processes; concurrent admission was not measured
Host result reconciliation does not repair the native checkpoint
Cancellation is injected at tool boundaries; distributed workers were not measured

findings.title: 旧对照表混淆本地适配与上游能力
findings.resolution: 重写为三列口径，引用官方中断/子图/权限文档，撤去通用性能胜负推论

findings.title: 取消包装异常未被宿主识别
findings.resolution: Deep Agents 适配器只将 NodeCancelledError 转为取消；取消前/后提交两条实际 worker 回归，初次失败报告保留

findings.title: ADR 将来源兼容默认误称为自动 fail-closed
findings.resolution: 明确未声明工具不会自动纳入来源治理，与现有源码和当前残余风险保持一致

findings.title: 测试 worker 环境继承无关 provider 凭据
findings.resolution: 环境改为必要键白名单并关闭 tracing/OTEL；新增未知 provider key、Logfire token 等排除回归

findings.title: 路由范围测试依赖框架内部懒加载结构
findings.resolution: 通过实际 OpenAPI 与 HTTP 验证新试点无旧聊天入口，保留 legacy finding 开放状态

findings.title: 模型输入记录缺少工具定义和部分消息字段
findings.resolution: 记录完整结构化消息、工具 schema 及模型接收参数；判分拒绝旧的纯文本记录；三方实际运行与缺证据负例回归。中断的旧候选清单与日志归档，不作为通过证据

findings.title: 嵌套对照项目配置进入源码包
findings.resolution: Hatch 的 basename include 匹配嵌套 pyproject；显式排除开发目录，增加包范围/拒绝嵌套配置回归，并检查真实 wheel/sdist；失败候选和打包日志保留

review_method: Local source review, actual subprocess experiments, negative scoring controls, full frozen gates, clean copy and package install; no independent professional review.

external_conditions.source: User answered none for real pilot prerequisites

phases.P1: first integration iteration qualified; native full fault matrix and independent onboarding incomplete

residual_risks: Fixed synthetic tenant/request host is an experiment, not a production IAM service
Shared host guarantees cannot establish native engine superiority
Source withdrawal tests cached-result replay, not native multi-turn history
Duplicate requests are sequential across processes; concurrent admission is not measured
Host reconciliation can finish while the native checkpoint still needs reconciliation
Task cancellation and process exit probes do not establish distributed lease/outbox recovery
No real-model quality, token cost, service latency, independent onboarding time or professional business result
Registry package bytes and transitive versions are lock-pinned; release Git commits were not separately verified
Original all-extras NLTK advisory PYSEC-2026-3740 retains its prior exception; no exception was applied to new comparison environments
